_note: M0-TH's manifest. One scope per thing checkable today; each lot that builds a §5 surface adds its scopes (docs/agent/testing.md). Plants: tests/plants/<plant>.patch, or a command for a plant on a file that moves (plan_lint).

plan_lint.desc: the plan's structure: every block, Flow row, status word, budget (plan.py lint)

plants.patch: {python} -S -c "import pathlib;p=pathlib.Path('milestones/m0/m0_implementation_plan.md');t=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8');assert '- Status: DONE' in t;p.write_text(t.replace('- Status: DONE','- Status: WIBBLE',1),encoding='utf-8')"

tools_selftest.desc: each annex tool's own red-armed selftest - proves the tools, never the game

toolchain.desc: the picked stack builds a one-file program: desktop (rustc 1.99), wasm32, and the web page through trunk 0.21.14 - not the game's GO

build.desc: the game's workspace builds and lints clean natively (cargo build + clippy -D warnings, release) and checks for wasm32-unknown-unknown (M0-T1)

registry.desc: the element, constant and reaction registries and the sandbox units (contract §1.5, §1.6, §2.1, §2.5.1, §2.7): elements.json's ten species verbatim and in order, physics.json's constants at their initial values, every bound at its edge (the ignition ladder, T_Si/T_H, Σ_N, ν, f_dep, κ_dust, the K pairs), each refusal naming its key, 1/μ, Y_e and Z_met of the solar mix against hand values, M0 = 2πΣc a²/3 (M0-T10); reactions.json's ten records verbatim, shares summing to 1 within 1e-12, keys resolving, ν ≥ 4, stand-ins disabled, each refusal naming its record (M0-T11)

eos.desc: the equation of state (contract §2.3.1-§2.3.3, §2.7): Π_th = Σε_th and T = με_th, the cold pressure P(x; K₁, K₂)'s two limits within 1e-6, u(x) = x∫P/s² tabulated on 512 log-spaced points over [1e-8, 1e8] and checked against the integral in closed form at the nodes, against both limits' closed forms, and between nodes within 1e-4 (the log-log interpolation), monotone, finite at the low end, K = 0 meaning no cold pressure, ε_th from E floored at T_floor/μ with the floor booked, c² = 2Π/Σ (M0-T12)

fft_twin.desc: the CPU twin's FFT and convolution, no GPU (contract §1.3.3, §1.4.2, §2.5.4): the radix-2 f64 FFT against a direct DFT on sizes 1…128 (1e-12 relative) and a delta and a plane wave exactly, inverse(forward) = identity at 32…2048 and in 2D, the 2D transform against the direct 2D DFT, Parseval at 16 × 8 and at 2048, the zero-padded convolution against direct summation on a 48 × 40 box with a kernel asymmetric in both axes (1e-10 relative, the box's edge cells checked rim by rim), mass in the four corners not wrapping, a single source reproducing the shifted kernel, the kernel's transform cached per padded size (sampled once for 48 × 40 and 50 × 41), padded sizes 32…2048 by the smallest power of two ≥ 2 × the axis and the refusals (M0-T28)

riemann.desc: the exact Riemann solution for an ideal γ = 2 gas, no GPU (contract §2.3.1, G-SOD §5.1, SM-O5, R8): the star-region pressure against an independent bisection on a pressure function written through the Rankine–Hugoniot mass flux and the Riemann invariant (1e-10 relative, seven wave pairs — Sod's, two rarefactions, two shocks, a strong shock, the mirrored Sod, a moving contact, a collision), Sod's pattern (left rarefaction, right shock) ordered, the Rankine–Hugoniot jumps of mass, momentum and energy across every shock and the isentrope and Riemann invariant across every fan and along Sod's fan (1e-10; the fan is the characteristic ξ = u − c), the contact continuous in p and u, the mirrored states giving the mirrored solution on a ξ grid, mass, momentum and energy conserved by Simpson between the wave positions (1e-8), the initial states far from the waves, and the refusals (a bad state, a vacuum) (M0-T33a); the oracle M0-T33b's twin case and M0-T34's GPU case read

sod.desc: gas flow on the CPU twin and on the GPU's P4 (contract §2.3.4, §2.8's bounce, §5.1's G-SOD, SM-O5, R8): sr_physics::reference::hydro — unsplit MUSCL-Hancock with the monotonised-central limiter on (Σ, u, v, Π, X_i), HLL with Davis speeds, species by the mass flux, the full EOS, two bounce ghosts a side — on Sod's tube cut from scenes/sod.json (a 400 × 64 world, §2.8's floor; ρ 1 | 0.125, P 1 | 0.1, at rest, cold pressure off by `overrides`; the twin's strip is its first four rows, 400 × 4) read at t = 80 against M0-T33a's exact Riemann solution: the shock within 1 cell (measured 0.34, from the density's halfway crossing) and the L1 density error ≤ 2 % (measured 0.32 %, against the exact density averaged over each cell); the scene file itself (Σ, Π, at rest, hydrogen, bounce, cold off, only hydro on); mass and energy conserved to 1e-12 and the x momentum the walls' pressure gives, (P_L − P_R)·t·rows, to 1e-10; the 64-row scene world's every row the strip's (1e-13), the tube mirrored in x giving the mirrored run and a strip laid along y (4 × 400) the x run, both within 1e-12 (the y fluxes graded); hydrogen | helium with the same Σ and Π leaving Σ, momenta and E as the pure-hydrogen run's (1e-12), ΣX_i = 1 (1e-12), X_H within [0, 1] and its half crossing within 2 cells of u*·t; with the shipped cold pressure on (electron share of Π over 20 %), Σ finite and positive, mass and energy to 1e-12 and the walls' momentum to 1e-10 (M0-T33b); the GPU's P4 (step/hydro.rs, shaders/hydro.wgsl, its update and commit over the box) on the physics adapter, the scene's 400 × 64 world to the first step at t ≥ 80, graded at that time: the shock within 1 cell and the L1 density error ≤ 2 % on every row (measured 0.335 cell, 0.319 %, RTX 5090), every row within 1e-5 of row 0 and |v| ≤ 1e-5 (a y-flux defect), mass and energy to 1e-5 relative and the walls' momentum to 1e-4, the tube laid along y (64 × 400) the x run step for step within 1e-5 (the adversarial case), the shipped cold pressure on to t = 20 finite, positive, conserving — f32 tolerances fixed before the first GPU run (M0-T34); hll-swap plants the left state in the twin's and the shader's HLL

edges.desc: G-EDGE, both edges (contract §2.8, §2.9's escaped, §5.1, R8): on the CPU twin (sr_physics::reference::hydro, Edge::Leave — ghosts copying the edge cell with the normal velocity clamped outward, HLL against the ghost's predicted face, a face whose mass flux points inward made a wall, escaped booked per boundary face from that flux) and on the GPU's P4 (shaders/hydro.wgsl: leave ghosts in read_at, `boundary`, `hydro_edges` booking booking.escaped; step/hydro.rs's edge uniform, Step::set_edge_mode) on the physics adapter. Bounce: scenes/edge_pulse.json, a right-going acoustic pulse (v0 = 0.002, Mach 1.4e-3) in a 256 × 64 world at rest, read at t = 200 — the pulse's mass-weighted normal velocity within 2 % of −v0 (measured 0.001 % twin, 0.020 % GPU), the walls' mass flux 0 (mass 2e-16 twin, 1.5e-7 GPU) and nothing booked; the GPU's bounce against the twin's mirror ghosts on a Mach-0.5 wind against two walls to t = 20, Σ, Σu, Σv, E within 1e-4 relative L1 (measured ≤ 1.0e-6) — the pulse oracle cannot see the ghosts (copy in place of mirror moves it by < 1e-6), this case can (the twin moves 2.6e-4 … 2.6e-3). Leave: the wind (128 × 64 at (0.6, 0.4), a helium block riding it) to t = 40, 39.6 % of the mass out — the grid's mass loss equal to escaped to 1e-6 of escaped (measured 1.2e-15 twin, 2.7e-8 GPU; the twin every component to 1e-12), inflow exactly 0 (no face's booked mass ever falls in a step: the twin every step, the GPU's booking read every step), the GPU's escaped within G-REF's 1e-3 of the twin's (≤ 8e-8); set_edge_mode between two submissions — bounce 64 steps then leave 64 — bit for bit a leave run started at step 64; a world that names no edge leaves (D1) (M0-T35). wall-copy plants copy ghosts in the shader's bounce

collapse.desc: G-COLL, the cold collapse (contract §1.4.2's gravity source, §5.1, SM-O2, SM-C2, R8): scenes/cold_disk.json — a cold Maclaurin disk (Σc = 1, a = 40, T_floor, at rest, hydrogen) about the centre of a 128 × 128 leave world, gravity and hydro on, heat, reactions, neutrinos and sinks off, the cold pressure off through `overrides` naming the four K's and nothing else (every other constant the shipped one: the adversarial case) — falls in homologously: r50(t)/r50(0) = cos²η at t/t_ff = (2/π)(η + ½ sin 2η), t_ff = ½√(a/GΣc) = 3.162, so 0.8368 at 0.5 t_ff and 0.5279 at 0.8 t_ff, each within 3 % (r50 about the centre of mass, each cell's mass over 4 × 4 points of its area). The CPU twin (reference::hydro's step_with: the Hancock predictor's half kick on every face state, the update's Δt·Σg and Δt·(Σu)·g from the predictor's half-step centre; g from reference::grav over the world each step; the last step cut to the read time) measured +0.17 % and +1.34 %; the GPU's P2 + P4 (hydro.wgsl's accel_at, kicked and the update's source, g bound at 14 in hydro_update and hydro_edges, the next state repacked into two buffers of 7 planes) on the physics adapter, read at the first step past each time, the oracle at that time, measured +0.15 % and +1.34 % (RTX 5090); the oracle's own arithmetic against §5.1's numbers (M0-T36). grav-half plants g × 0.5 where the twin's and the shader's P4 read it

twin.desc: the twin's step driver and `headless --cpu-reference` (contract §1.3.2, §1.7, §3.3, R13; M0-T37): sr_physics::reference::Twin runs the passes built so far in §1.3.2's order on f64 planes — P1 Δt, P2 gravity, P4 hydro, P8 floors, P9 Δt_{n+1}, the scene's switches honoured — and reference::floors is P8 moved out of tests/gpu/floors.rs per §2.7 [M0-T19]; a 64 × 64 sun-like disk (`--scene preset:sun --world 64x64`, every switch on) run by `--cpu-reference` writes dumps (every 8 of 24 steps) byte for byte the in-process twin's, summary.json's steps and sim_time the twin's and its adapter `cpu-reference`; a world of 200 × 200, 136 × 64 or 64 × 136 is refused with exit 4 and writes no summary, 128 × 128 runs; `--adapter`, `--timing` and `--load-dump` are refused with it (exit 4); the driver's pass list printed beside the GPU step's for each of the four gravity/hydro switch pairs, equal to it (the adversarial line: a twin that skips a pass the GPU runs agrees with nothing in G-REF); P8 in the driver books what it changes (hydro and gravity off: ΔΣ = −vacuum_reset and ΔE = floor_added over the disk's vacuum, per cell summed, 1e-9 relative, the corner cell the floor state, ΣX = 1); the driver steps the GPU's way — Δt_n from the end of step n − 1, P9's gravity term from step n's own P2 — bit for bit against a hand-written loop over scenes/cold_disk.json for 12 steps, and visibly not as the fresh-g loop of tests/gpu/collapse.rs (they differ by 4e-5 in Σ), on the physics adapter for the GPU step's pass list only (R12, R15). twin-skip-floors drops P8 from the driver's step

cpu_gpu.desc: G-REF, the GPU against the CPU twin (contract §5.1, §2.2, §6.7, ES-E20, R8, R13; M0-T38): the GPU's f32 step (P2 + P4 + P8, the box fit, the scene's switches and edge) and sr_physics::reference::Twin's f64 step run the same scene for exactly 200 steps and their states are read side by side — relative L1 difference of Σ and of E at most 1e-3, the largest absolute difference of each X at most 1e-4 (read where both Σ ≥ Σ_floor / 1e-4 = 1e-4: below it P8's floor matter alone can move an X by the band) — on scenes/ref_disk.json (64 × 64, leave: a cold Maclaurin disk a = 24, Σc = 1, H 0.75 / He 0.25, gravity and hydro on, the four cold-pressure K's off by `overrides` and nothing else) and scenes/ref_sod.json (64 × 64, bounce: Sod's strip ρ 1 | 0.125, P 1 | 0.1, hydrogen | helium, the K's off, hydro only; the shock reflected inside the 200 steps), each case printing its sim times, both L1 differences and its largest |ΔX| (SR-REF), on the physics adapter (R12). The burning field joins with M0-T48. The twin's own CFL is read from physics.json and the GPU's from the same key in step/dt.rs: cfl-gpu plants 0.4 → 0.39 in the GPU's alone, 2.5 % short in sim time at step 200

heat_gauss.desc: G-HEAT1 and the light leaving, on the CPU twin (contract §2.4, §1.7, §5.1, SM-O7, SM-E21, R8, R13; M0-T41; the GPU's cases join with M0-T42): sr_physics::reference::heat — one-temperature flux-limited diffusion stepped by RKL2, no adapter touched — on scenes/heat_pulse.json (128 × 128, bounce, heat only, test.constant_diffusivity 0.5, a background at T_floor) with a Gaussian of σ₀ = 4 added by the test: σ² per axis at t = 8, 16, 24 within 1 % of σ₀² + 2χt (measured 1e-12) and the total heat constant to 1e-5 (measured 1.4e-14); the flux kept equal to −χ·C·ΔT at x and y faces, positive toward +x, +y, the cell field the mean of a cell's two faces; a hot slab (T = 30, 32 × 32 at the world's left edge, vacuum around) whose booked `radiated` equals the heat the grid lost to 1e-6 (measured 0 at 1e-9), each cell's `emitted` nonzero exactly on the slab's ring and every vacuum cell untouched bit for bit; test.pin_temperature leaving the planes bit for bit and keeping F; scenes/heat_pulse.json and heat_spot.json carry what the oracles assume. chi-scale plants χ × 0.9 in the constant-diffusivity branch

heat_rkl2.desc: G-HEAT2, RKL2 super-time-stepping on the CPU twin (contract §2.4.3, §5.1, SM-O8, SM-E18, R8, R13; M0-T41): one RKL2 pass over t = 24 (14 stages) and the explicit sub-steps the test writes (96 of Δt_p/2) both at σ² within 1 % of σ₀² + 2χt and of each other (measured 1e-12); six passes of Δt = 4 (6 stages) against the explicit field within 1 % of the pulse's peak (measured 2.7e-3) and the analytic Gaussian; the stage count against the contract's formula worked by hand for eight steps from 0.05 to 100 (the smallest s ≥ 2 with Δt_p (s² + s − 2)/4 ≥ Δt, Δt_p = 0.5), `SR-WARN heat stages 33` above 32 and not at 32; the adversarial case — a one-cell pulse, 15 passes of Δt = 6.4 Δt_p (5 stages, the step just over what 4 cover), read as the difference of two runs on a background of 2.0: σ² within 1 % of the explicit run's and of 2χt, total heat to 1e-6, the ringing (−2.3 % of the pulse, measured) bounded and gone by the end. rkl2-s-minus-one plants one stage fewer in the twin

heat_limiter.desc: G-FLD, the flux limiter on the CPU twin (contract §2.4.1, §5.1, SM-E19, SM-E20, R8, R13; M0-T41): Levermore–Pomraning's λ(R) = (2 + R)/(6 + 3R + R²) at five closed-form points, λR < 1 and λ falling; scenes/heat_spot.json (64 × 64 thin gas, Σ = 10⁻⁴, a hot 8 × 8 spot at T = 2, leave edges) over 20 passes: |F| ≤ c_sb a_r T⁴ of the hotter side (1 + 10⁻⁶) at every face including the world's edges, and the limiter binding (worst ratio 0.98, measured); the same spot with test.flux_limiter off at 1,667 times the bound — the check can fail; thick gas (Σ = 100, κΣ = 200, a gentle gradient) carrying (4/3) a_r c_sb T³/(κΣ) within 1 % (measured 1e-6); the flag off giving c_sb ΔE/(3 κΣ_face) across a face of the spot to 1e-9. limiter-off plants λ ≡ 1/3

grav_force.desc: gravity's force law on the CPU twin and on the GPU's P2, on the physics adapter (contract §1.4.2, §5.1's G-GRAV1, §2.3.5): K(0, 0) = −G·4 ln(1 + √2) = −3.525494 G asserted (closed form against a polar quadrature, 1e-12) with K = −G/r elsewhere, symmetric and linear in G, one unit of Σ giving that self cell and −G/r around it; a Maclaurin disk Σc√(1 − r²/a²) on a grid, φ = K ∗ Σ_src by the zero-padded FFT convolution and g = −∇φ by central differences: |Δg|/|g| ≤ 2 % at every cell with 0 < r ≤ 0.75a for a = 40 (the largest error and its cell printed; measured 0.30 %, so the direct force kernels stay unbuilt), the a = 20 over a = 40 largest error within [1.6, 2.4] (measured 1.93), a disk centred on a cell corner (the scene files' convention) within 2 % too (M0-T29); the GPU's P2 (step/grav.rs, shaders/grav.wgsl) on one step of the a = 40 disk in a 128 × 128 world within 2 % (measured 0.30 %), a = 20 over a = 40 within [1.6, 2.4] (1.93), φ and g over the fitted box within G-REF's 1e-3 relative L1 of the twin (measured ≤ 3e-6), P9's Δt_0 and Δt_1 = min(hydro term, η_g / √max|g|) within 1e-6 with the gravity term binding, and a frame's φ, g and Δt the bare steps', bit for bit (M0-T31); K(i, j) = −G/√(i² + j²) at every offset of a 64 × 64 box within 4e-16 relative, K(0, 0) exact; the GPU on a faint disk in sub-Σ_vac cells (the mask), on a wide box (392 × 64, FFT 1024 × 128), a tall one (40 × 344, 128 × 1024) and the whole 600 × 400 world (2048 × 1024): φ and g within G-REF's 1e-3 of the twin and φ at nine cells within 1e-4 of the kernel summed directly over the sources (M0-D25)

grav_selfforce.desc: gravity's net self-force on the CPU twin and on the GPU's P2, on the physics adapter (contract §1.4.2, §5.1's G-GRAV2): scenes/asym_blob.json (a Maclaurin disk and an off-centre rectangle, 128 × 128) and a seeded scatter of masses in a 50 × 37 box, φ = K ∗ Σ_src and g = −∇φ by central differences: |Σ m·g| ≤ 1e-5 Σ m|g| (printed; measured 4e-16), the blob a real one (over 1500 cells, mass over 500, Σ m|g| over 100) (M0-T29); the blob through one GPU step with gravity on, over the fitted box: the same ratio (measured 2e-9 in f32) and φ and g within G-REF's 1e-3 relative L1 of the twin (M0-T31); a wide box (392 × 64, FFT 1024 × 128) and a tall one (40 × 344, 128 × 1024), each with an empty outermost ring: the same ratio and the same twin bound (M0-D25)

fft.desc: the GPU FFT and the convolution over the box (contract §1.3.3, §1.4.2, §6.2.2), on the physics adapter at WebGPU's default limits: 2D complex transforms against M0-T28's twin on random fields at 64 × 64, 256 × 128 and 2048 × 1024, and every length 32 … 2048 on both axes — forward, and the inverse of the twin's spectrum — within 1e-5 relative L2, 2 dispatches each; the zero-padded convolution (3 dispatches) against the twin's with an asymmetric kernel on boxes off the origin, at the world's corners and one row tall, and gravity's kernel over the whole 600 × 400 world (2048 × 1024), within 1e-5 relative L2, cells outside the box untouched; the kernel's transform cached per padded size; the refusals; the cost per convolution at TW's three box sizes in the log, not graded (M0-T30)

time_control.desc: time control, no GPU (contract §1.8, §3.2, §4.3, §4.12): the ladder and TOP / 1.5, the game at ×1 running, select/faster/slower at the ends, N = min(N_max, ⌈owed/Δt_est⌉) with owed booked from read-back frames and bounded to [−Δt_est, one frame], N_max from the 16-frame c_step average and R_reserve, the cap readout at 30 of the last 60 frames, 10,000 capped frames then ×0.1 with no backlog, pause and one step per press, the slow-down only ever slower with no auto-return, the latch's stopped steps never owed, the 30-frames switch at TOP (30 of 60, 120 quiet), the empty world's Δt survived, speed text at two significant digits (M0-T24)

strings.desc: the string table (contract §4.1, §5.4 G-STR): crates/sr-app/src/strings.rs and the contract's `strings` block hold the same keys, each way, with byte-identical texts (× — ≈ · … compared as bytes), and web/index.html carries each web.* text verbatim; the test includes strings.rs by #[path] because sr-app is bin-only (M0-T13)

adapter.desc: the GPU adapter choice (contract §6.1-§6.3, §6.2.2): the matching rule on a fixed list, and a live headless device per adapter this box has, at WebGPU's default limits (M0-T2); box's adapters named in the log

state.desc: the cell state and the step loop (contract §2.2, §2.8, §1.3.2, §1.3.4): WorldConfig's sizes, a 600 × 400 upload/readback round trip bit-exact, P0-P9's order, P8's species renormalisation (Σ X = 1 within 1e-6, other channels bit-identical), two runs bit-identical (M0-T3); on the physics adapter (R12, R15)

booking.desc: the side fields and the booking layout (contract §2.2, §1.9.1, §2.9, §1.3.4): every §2.9 booked term and §1.9.1 accumulator listed with its writer pass; a test pipeline books known values into every slot over 16 steps, each term's f64 total (book_totals) equal to the closed form within 1e-9 relative; two runs bit-identical; the clear empties every term (M0-T18); on the physics adapter (R12, R15)

floors.desc: P8 complete and the equation of state on the GPU (contract §1.3.2, §1.5, §2.3.2-§2.3.3, §2.7, §2.9): eos.wgsl's helpers (1/μ, Y_e, Z_met, Π_e, Π_n, ε_cold from M0-T12's u(x) table, Π, c², T) against sr_physics::eos with the cold pairs on and off; P8 lists floor_cells ahead of renormalise_species; a 64 × 64 field of vacuum, cold, dense cold and hot cells with normalised, unnormalised, mixed-sign and all-≤0 fractions → one step → vacuum cells at the floor state, cold cells at T_floor (2e-5 relative of the f64 twin), hot cells bit-identical, fractions renormalised (1e-6), vacuum_reset and floor_added equal to the mass and energy changed within 1e-6 relative, cell by cell and in total (M0-T19); cells holding a NaN or an Inf fraction left bit-identical for P9's guard, nothing booked, every other cell as the clean run (M0-D18); on the physics adapter (R12, R15)

dt.desc: P1 Δt, P9's Δt reduction and the non-finite guard (contract §1.3.2 P1 and P9, §1.3.4, §2.3.3, §2.3.5, §3.3): P1 holds dt_advance, P9 dt_cells and dt_partials, plus guard_scan and guard_stamp every 64th step; Δt against §2.3.5's formula in f64 (C = 0.4, η_g = 0.3, the gravity term infinite until P2) on fields of known u and c, the cold pairs off, 64 × 64, 72 × 88 and 600 × 400, within 1e-6 relative; step 0 on the initial state's reduction and step n on the value P9 made at the end of step n − 1; Δt and the state bit-identical over two 130-step runs on 600 × 400; a NaN and an Inf planted at known cells and steps → the guard's step, cell and channel (M0-T20); a NaN x_C planted before step 0 → named by step 0's scan, its cell's fractions as planted (M0-D18); on the physics adapter (R12, R15)

box.desc: the active box (contract §1.3.3, §1.3.2, §1.3.4; G-BOX's box half, its conservation cases, M0-T39: scenes/sun_disk.json in the box against the whole world, every sum to 1e-6 of its scale at step 200 with the box inside the world and the masses at 2,000 (contract §0.5 [M0-T39]), and scenes/box_blob.json's blob at 0.35 cells per step in bounce mode, its masses to 1e-6): the bounding box of Σ ≥ Σ_vac cells grown by 8, rounded out to 8, clamped to the world — blobs in the middle, on and off the 8-grid, at each edge and corner, a block, two far corners, Σ = Σ_vac and the next f32 below, the empty world — exactly; the FFT size per axis (smallest power of two ≥ 2 × the box, at least 32; up to 4096 on a 2048-wide world); the re-fit after P9 at step indices ≡ 0 (mod 16) only, and in P0 when the edit flag is set (cleared by the fit); P8's two dispatches and dt_cells sized indirectly from the box's buffer, P8 leaving the vacuum outside the box as uploaded, Δt over the box against the f64 formula (1e-6); the whole-world switch (M0-T21); on the physics adapter (R12, R15)

latch.desc: a frame of steps and the collapse latch (contract §1.8.3, §1.8.5, §1.8.7, §3.1; G-LATCH's mechanism — its contract scenario arrives with M0-T111, until then NOT PROVEN (synthetic)): a test hook sets the flag in P6 at step k of a 40-step frame (k = 1, 15, 40; 15 puts the re-fit after step index 16 inside the stopped stretch) → exactly k steps run, the state, the Δt record and the box bit-identical to a k-step run, no box-sized dispatch after step k, the next frame whole; slow-down off → all 40; re-armed only after 1.0 t.u. without a set (Δt ≈ 0.447 checked first); P0's gate zeroed when an edit is flagged on the firing step; poll() reports each frame once, in order, without waiting (M0-T22); on the physics adapter (R12, R15)

timing.desc: GPU timestamps, the cost per step and headless --timing (contract §1.8.3's c_step, §2.12.2's timing, §3.1's poll(), §3.3, §6.2.2): with timing on, every pass a step records (P0 always, then each pass with a dispatch) is timed at its compute-pass boundaries, positive, no other pass named, their sum within 40 % of the step's cost (first pass's beginning to last pass's end; TW's submission-overhead note) — over bare steps (read_cost), frames (poll()'s FrameReport.cost, frame begin + end timed, two frames in flight each with its own steps) and a 1000-step frame that outgrows the 4096-query set (its first whole steps timed, the next frame fresh); the device holds no feature but timestamp-query, and that one only where the adapter offers it; the wall-clock fallback names itself and times no pass; timing off → no cost; headless --timing on the nominal disk (in-process, the function the binary forwards to) writes summary.json's timing with every recorded pass in per_pass_ms, step_ms_mean and source, and no timing key without the flag (M0-T23). A mechanism scope, not a ⏱ one: no speed is graded, so it runs on the physics adapter (R12, R15)

scene.desc: scene files (contract §2.12.1, §2.12.4, §2.10's cloud, §2.8's world and edge, §3.3's headless --scene --world --edge): an unknown key refused at every level (top, world, switches — the misspelt hydor — test, each object kind, composition), naming its path, and through headless as exit 4 with no summary; t with pressure refused, neither refused; overrides only physics.json keys, within physics.json's bounds, a scene with overrides never writing calibration; objects where §2.12.4 puts them (x right, y down, cell centres, rects clipped), overlapping objects adding, a resized world keeping them about its centre, an object off the world a warning; E from t and Π from pressure through the EOS, a pressure under the cold pressure refused; a disk's mass read back from the GPU against 2πΣc a²/3 within the outer ring's bound 2√2 a^-3/2; every file in scenes/ parsing, sun_disk.json the preset:sun planes bit for bit, fill_world.json filling every world shape; headless --scene scenes/sun_disk.json --world 256x256 --edge bounce --steps 5 writing summary.json's scene and world as given (M0-T25)

dump.desc: state dumps (contract §2.12.3 with §0.5 [M0-T26]'s resume key, §3.1's load_dump and dump_state, §3.3's --dump-every and --load-dump, §1.3.4): the bytes read by hand — SRDUMP01, the u32 header length, the header's eight keys (version, width, height, step, sim_time, channels in §2.2's order, sinks, resume), 14 little-endian f32 planes row-major, Σ, mom_x and mom_y found at §2.2's indices by the start's values — then read back to the same dump and the same bytes, through a file, and load_dump → dump_state bit for bit; 2 × 100 steps through a dump (frames under the latch, a fire on the dump's last step, a second flag 2 Δt later) equal 200 straight steps — the state, the Δt record, the box and every frame report — and the cells alone visibly do not; headless 100 + --load-dump 100 writes the 200-step run's s_150 and s_200 byte for byte, --dump-every 50 at step indices from the scene, the final dump always, a --world other than the dump's and --dump-every without --out exit 4; a dump cut anywhere, one byte too long, a wrong magic, an unknown or missing key, another version, world or channel list refused, naming it, and through headless exit 4 with no summary (M0-T26); one sim time per step count — 40 steps as 1 × 40, 2 × 20, 40 × 1 frames and bare give byte-identical dumps, the reports' sim time the dump's, within 1e-9 relative of the f64 sum of each step's f32 Δt in order (the f32 sum visibly not); an empty world's steps (Δt the largest f32) add none; headless --steps 100 writes summary.json's and the final dump's sim_time equal, its in-process twin's, within the bound (M0-D21); on the physics adapter (R12, R15)

boot.desc: the headless boot (contract §3.3, §3.4, §5.4 G-BOOT): launch.py smoke of headless-boot is ready within 60 s and its summary.json carries every §2.12.2 key with steps = 200; stdout opens with SR-ADAPTER and ends with SR-HEADLESS DONE steps=200 (M0-T4); the build is the tree's own

desktop.desc: the desktop boot (contract §3.3, §3.4, §3.6, §5.4 G-DESK): launch.py smoke of the box's window route — game-xvfb (private Xvfb, lavapipe) on linux-pc, game-offscreen on win-laptop (R15) — reads /status "ready" within 90 s, raised by the first presented frame (M0-T5), and the double-click launcher fed its Enter on the same route - starts, reaches ready, stops, leaves nothing running (M0-T6); the build is the tree's own

web.desc: G-WEB (contract §3.5, §6.2.1, §6.2.4, §5.4, §6.2.3): case build - trunk build --release writes web/dist with index.html, the .wasm and the wasm-bindgen glue; index.html keeps the canvas, the web.* texts and the inline WebGPU check ahead of the wasm, trunk's auto-loader stripped (M0-T7); cases ready and no-webgpu - web/smoke.mjs drives the box's installed Chrome (playwright-core, headless, §6.2.3's flags) against the `web` service launch.py starts over web/dist (M0-T15): `/` reaches srState "ready" within 30 s and srAdapter is logged; `/?no-webgpu=1` shows srState "no-webgpu" and the three web.no_webgpu_* texts exactly; both read Chrome's command line from chrome://version and refuse a run with --no-sandbox (chromiumSandbox on, M0-D17). Each case builds first when web/dist is not fresh against its inputs

capture.desc: the capture harness, first form (contract §3.3, M0-T8): --capture <script> --out <dir> on the box's window route (xvfb-run + llvmpipe on linux-pc, --offscreen-window on win-laptop, R15) writes one PNG per step of the window's size, the two steps' pixels differ (paused vs running), and a valid captions.json in review_page.py's shape, exit 0; an action not built yet, an unknown action and a bad id are each refused with SR-ERROR, exit 4; the build is the tree's own

licences.desc: G-LIC, no copyleft (contract §5.4, R7): `cargo metadata --locked --filter-platform <target>` over the workspace for the native host and for wasm32-unknown-unknown; every package the target resolves to has a licence expression with an alternative made only of §5.4's list (OR, AND, WITH parsed, `/` read as OR; one named exception, epaint_default_fonts, contract §0.5 [M0-T14]); a missing licence or any other is NO-GO naming the package. The parser's own fixed-expression checks run first in each case. `npm ls --all --json` in web/ is case `npm` (M0-T14, added with web/package.json by M0-T15)

watch_only.desc: G-WATCH, labels watch and never drive (contract §1.1, §5.4; M0-T16): a static scan - no file under crates/sr-engine/src/step/ or crates/sr-engine/shaders/ names `observe`, `Stage`, `Tracker` or a §2.11 calibration key other than `physics_hash` (the keys read from the contract's schema line); the log counts the files scanned (≥ 2), an empty folder is NO-GO, a hit names file and line

skip_classes.reason: the harness's own manifest and anchor - a wrong entry shows as a red or an uncovered scope, never graded by one
instruction and config files - no scope grades text; the lead reads them

reports, tasks, the contract and docs - until a scope reads one (the `strings` scope reads the contract's strings block, M0-T13, and takes that file out of this class by its paths), a V block reads them
